libs.note: BH-3481.4: the mid-build spend tripwire. A build trips when its spend (the build's cost.csv plus the live session) passes BUILD_TRIPWIRE_MULT x expected, where expected = usd_per_pr x the plan's shape factor, or when BUILD_TRIPWIRE_REPEAT_MAX paid rows carry one guard_fp. A trip writes $BUILD/TRIPWIRE, the ledger row build-tripwire "<project> <KEY>" = paused and one critical page; the next launch of the ticket is refused until an operator writes `released`. Thresholds are multiples of the operator's own usd_per_pr (conf.cost-caps.* rows / catalog/cost-caps.conf through cost_budget_for); there is no dollar budget anywhere in the tripwire. Resolved at call time with lib_env_apply build-tripwire; tests/build-tripwire.bh-3501-test.sh drives it.

knobs.note: Master switch for the build tripwire. 1 = on, 0 = off: no new trips (a build whose dir already holds TRIPWIRE stays paused). Read as ${BUILD_TRIPWIRE:-1}.

The spend rule: a build trips when its spend is more than this many times its expected spend (usd_per_pr x shape factor). Thresholds are multiples of the operator's own usd_per_pr (conf.cost-caps.* rows / catalog/cost-caps.conf through cost_budget_for); there is no dollar budget anywhere in the tripwire. Read as ${BUILD_TRIPWIRE_MULT:-5}.
The factor on usd_per_pr for a build whose plan's last `SIZE:` line is S: expected = usd_per_pr x this. Read by bin/lib/build-tripwire.sh as ${BUILD_TRIPWIRE_SHAPE_S:-0.5}.
The factor on usd_per_pr for a build whose plan's last `SIZE:` line is M: expected = usd_per_pr x this. Read by bin/lib/build-tripwire.sh as ${BUILD_TRIPWIRE_SHAPE_M:-1}.
The factor on usd_per_pr for a build whose plan's last `SIZE:` line is L: expected = usd_per_pr x this. Read by bin/lib/build-tripwire.sh as ${BUILD_TRIPWIRE_SHAPE_L:-2}.

The factor on usd_per_pr for a build whose plan's last `SIZE:` line is XL, and also a build with no plan.md or no readable SIZE line: expected = usd_per_pr x this. Read by bin/lib/build-tripwire.sh as ${BUILD_TRIPWIRE_SHAPE_XL:-3}.

The repeat rule: this many paid rows (cost_usd > 0) in one build's cost.csv with the same non-empty guard_fp trip the build. 0 = unarmed, via env or a zero_means row; a settings row is clamped to 2..50. Read as ${BUILD_TRIPWIRE_REPEAT_MAX:-4}.
